all_parameter_rank_theorem.initial_boundary: n=0 gives B_k^0=I and full rank 3^k
all_parameter_rank_theorem.normal_form: for n=qk+r, B_k^n is a tensor-factor rotation after r factors A^(q+1) and k-r factors A^q

closed_parent.result: B_k,closed is unitary, rank(B_k,closed^n)=3^k, and its escape exponent is zero

hole_position.rank_result: the zero root is simple and the other two roots are nonzero, so rank(A0^m)=2 for every m>=1 and the full rank law is unchanged
hole_position.trace_result: the trace cluster values can change; rank escape alone does not determine trace geometry

projector_order.result: the rank law and all fixed-period trace cluster sets are unchanged by unitary similarity

fixed_period_trace_theorem.cluster_set: for fixed n, merge equal values in {t_(n/d)^d:d divides n}
fixed_period_trace_theorem.every_divisor_class_infinite: k=d*(1+j*(n/d)) has gcd(n,k)=d for every j>=0
fixed_period_trace_theorem.normalized_limit: for fixed n, 3^(-k)*Tr(B_k^n)->0 because the numerator ranges over a finite cluster set

nonclaims: convergence of the unnormalized fixed-period traces for every n
a full growing-k secular determinant or resonance limit
a target divisor, functional equation, or counting law
prime-like information, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, or automorphy
a Hilbert--Polya operator or Route-B authorization

one_qutrit_theorem.reason: the simple zero generalized eigenspace has dimension one and both other eigenvalues are nonzero

source_lock.allowed_data: frozen DFT, rank-two projector, tensor shift, exact source traces
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zeros or divisors, primes, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya, Route B
source_lock.normalization: dimension normalization is 3^(-k); no spectral rescaling
source_lock.object: B_k(v0 tensor ... tensor v_(k-1))=v1 tensor ... tensor v_(k-1) tensor A*v0

unnormalized_nonconvergence_witness.conclusion: Tr(B_k^2) has distinct odd-k and even-k constant subsequences, so no k->infinity limit
